description: This file defines a serializer class for converting JavaScript values into a structured format suitable for communication, including handling special cases like circular references, RegExp, Date, and primitive types.

classes.name: UnserializableError
classes.description: Custom error class used internally to indicate serialization issues.

classes.name: BidiSerializer
classes.description: Provides static methods to serialize various JavaScript data types into a structured format.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes a value of unknown type into a Bidi.Script.LocalValue format.

methods.name: _serializeNumber
methods.description: Serializes a number, handling special cases like -0, Infinity, -Infinity, and NaN.

methods.name: _serializeObject
methods.description: Serializes objects, arrays, RegExp, Date, and null, with checks for circular references.
